messages.content: The freight carrier just moved the Denver crate delivery to Monday at 4:30 p.m. I need to be at the gallery by 1:30 for the dock setup, so the flight we booked is now too late. Can you see whether I can move only the outbound earlier and leave Thursday evening alone?

Yes. I’ll keep the Thursday, August 21 Delta return at 6:40 p.m. unchanged and look at earlier Delta options from Atlanta for Monday, August 18. I’ll also check the change cost before making anything final.
Good. I do not want to disturb the hotel dates either. It is still Monday through Thursday.

The best same-day option is a Delta nonstop leaving Atlanta at 7:05 a.m. and arriving in Denver at 8:24 a.m. Monday. Your 6:40 p.m. Thursday return remains available on the same itinerary. Changing the outbound increases the ticket by $42, with no separate change fee, so the airfare would rise from $446 to $488.
That works on timing. Is there anything earlier that is less expensive?

There is a 6:15 a.m. departure connecting in Minneapolis and reaching Denver at 10:47 a.m. It adds $18 instead of $42, but the connection gives you less protection against a delay before the 1:30 gallery arrival. The 7:05 a.m. nonstop gets in more than two hours earlier.
Use the 7:05 nonstop. With the extra $42, where does that put the trip total?
The revised expected total is $1,232.22: $488 airfare, $674.22 lodging, and an estimated $70 for the checked bag round trip unless a waiver applies. That remains within the $1,250 approval by $17.78.

All right. Before you change it, check Catbird. I know the reservation starts Monday, but I may get there well before the room is ready. Ask whether they can either let me in early or hold my luggage until after the delivery.

Catbird confirms that reservation CB-481730 remains valid for August 18-21. Standard check-in is at 4:00 p.m. An early room is not guaranteed, but the front desk will store your luggage at no charge from your arrival Monday until you return from the gallery. They have added an expected arrival note for approximately 9:15 a.m.; no room or date change is required.
Does adding that note affect the cancellation deadline or total?
No. The hotel total remains $674.22, and free cancellation is still available until 6:00 p.m. Denver time on Sunday, August 17. The arrival note and luggage storage do not add a charge.
Then change the outbound to the 7:05 Delta flight. Keep the Thursday 6:40 return, the checked-bag notation, and the existing hotel exactly as they are. No extras or insurance.

The change is ready at a $42 additional charge, bringing the Delta ticket to $488. The return, bag notation, and Catbird booking are unchanged. Shall I complete the exchange using the payment method on the existing ticket?

The exchange is confirmed under Delta confirmation H7Q4LM. You now depart Atlanta Monday, August 18 at 7:05 a.m. and arrive Denver at 8:24 a.m.; the Thursday, August 21 return remains at 6:40 p.m., arriving Atlanta at 11:32 p.m. The additional $42 was charged to the existing payment method, making the airfare $488. Catbird confirmation CB-481730 remains August 18-21 at $674.22, with complimentary luggage storage noted for Monday morning and no guaranteed early room. The expected trip total is $1,232.22 including the estimated $70 round-trip bag cost. No insurance or optional extras were added.
